`github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2` from 2.11.7 to 2.11.9
Release notes

Sourced from github.com/caddyserver/caddy/v2's releases.

v2.11.9

This is a quick follow-up on top of 2.11.8, to fix a regression it introduced and a few more security issues, mostly in FastCGI. It contains only fixes backported from master, plus a couple of small additions. If you're on 2.11.8 and serve PHP, we recommend upgrading.

Huge thank you to our sponsors for keeping the project alive with resources, and for our maintainers who triage and assist tirelessly in this relentless new age of AI.

Highlights

  • Fixed: PHP directory indexes (regression in 2.11.8). A request for a directory with a trailing slash, like /wp-admin/, was matched by the directory itself instead of its index.php, so it never reached PHP and usually got a 404. This broke WordPress admin pages and other apps that serve an index through a trailing-slash URL. A try_files pattern now only matches a directory when it ends in /. Thanks @​dunglas! (#8352)
  • Path matchers with placeholders now work as expected: placeholders like {env.FOO} are no longer lower-cased into {env.foo} before they're looked up, and their values are compared case-insensitively against the request path, like static patterns. Thanks @​BenMacha! (#8343)
  • New plain_time_format option for file_server browse: sets the time layout of plain-text directory listings (Accept: text/plain). Thanks @​steffenbusch! (#8084)
  • Fewer allocations in path cleaning, header rewriting and weighted_round_robin selection. Thanks @​jvoisin! (#7842)
  • For plugin authors: new httpcaddyfile.Helper.IsNamedRoute() tells a directive whether it's being parsed inside a named route. (#8354)

:warning: Breaking changes

  • Conflicting client_auth is now a Caddyfile error. When two site blocks share TLS connection policies for the same hostname but set different client_auth, the adapter used to keep the first one and silently drop the other, which could quietly remove a stricter mTLS requirement. (#8306)
  • FastCGI requests that are ambiguous about which script they run get 400:
    • when the escaped path (which %-containing path matchers see) and the decoded path would select different scripts, e.g. /public/tool.php%2f..%2f..%2fadmin%2ftool.php (#8357)
    • on Windows, script paths with an 8.3 short name component (like ADMINI~1) or a : (NTFS alternate data streams) (#8356)
  • FastCGI env values now take precedence over request headers, so a client can no longer override HTTP_* variables you set with env (see below). (#8358)

Security fixes

Thank you to everyone who reported responsibly and helped with patches:

  • fastcgi: A client could override any HTTP_* variable set with the FastCGI transport's (or php_fastcgi's) env subdirective by sending a matching request header, for example choosing the user an application sees in HTTP_X_AUTH_USER. Configured values now win. Reported by @​JebeenLee and @​Camel4, fixed by @​dunglas. (GHSA-q34h-28rj-5hjm, #8358)
  • fastcgi: On Windows, NTFS 8.3 short names and alternate data streams could run a script that a path rule was meant to deny, completing the FastCGI fix from 2.11.8. Thanks @​dunglas. (GHSA-9cr8-wmhh-39pm, #8356)
  • fastcgi: Encoded slashes and dot segments could make a %-containing path matcher approve one script while another one runs. Thanks @​dunglas. (#8357)
  • fastcgi: Over HTTP/2, a host field sent next to :authority could make the application see a different host (HTTP_HOST) than the one Caddy routed the request to. Thanks @​dunglas. (#8355)
  • httpcaddyfile: A stricter client_auth could be silently dropped when merging TLS connection policies (see above). Thanks @​sam-kota. (#8306)
  • Updated go-jose to v4.1.6 for GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q. (#8299)

:warning: These security patches may be breaking if your application relies on the buggy behaviors.

:rotating_light: Notice for Caddy plugin maintainers: Dependabot will probably alert you to the security fixes in Caddy and urge you to upgrade it in your go.mod file. Please ONLY upgrade the Caddy dependency if there's a change to an exported API your plugin uses.

What's Changed

  • caddyhttp: lower-case path patterns with placeholders at request time by @​BenMacha in caddyserver/caddy#8343
  • httpcaddyfile: reject conflicting client_auth when merging TLS policies by @​sam-kota in caddyserver/caddy#8306
  • build(deps): bump the actions-deps group across 1 directory with 10 updates by @​dependabot[bot] in caddyserver/caddy#8340
  • build(deps): bump github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 from 4.1.5 to 4.1.6 by @​dependabot[bot] in caddyserver/caddy#8299
  • fileserver: make plain-text browse time format configurable by @​steffenbusch in caddyserver/caddy#8084
  • fileserver: only match a dir when the pattern ends by / by @​dunglas in caddyserver/caddy#8352
  • httpcaddyfile: add Helper.IsNamedRoute by @​dunglas in caddyserver/caddy#8354
  • fastcgi: take HTTP_HOST from the routed host only by @​dunglas in caddyserver/caddy#8355
  • fastcgi: reject Win 8.3 aliases and alt data streams paths by @​dunglas in caddyserver/caddy#8356
  • caddyhttp: presize buffers in hot paths to reduce allocations by @​jvoisin in caddyserver/caddy#7842
  • fastcgi: let configured env variables override request headers by @​dunglas in caddyserver/caddy#8358
  • fastcgi: reject paths whose escaped form selects another script by @​dunglas in caddyserver/caddy#8357

Release notes

Sourced from cel.dev/cel-go's releases.

Release v0.33.2

What's Changed

  • Changes to the fast-path list and map accessors to ensure graceful degradation for custom adaptors.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/cel-expr/cel-go/compare/v0.33.1...v0.33.2

Release v0.33.1

Cherry-picks for backwards compatibility with legacy timestamp and timezone formats, and support for google.protobuf.Value types as comprehension keys.

What's Changed

  • Release v0.33.1 cherry-picks by @​TristonianJones in cel-expr/cel-go#1590

Full Changelog: https://github.com/cel-expr/cel-go/compare/v0.33.0...v0.33.1

Release v0.33.0

This release introduces a high-performance Pratt parser, a unified declarative cost model (common/cost) with aggregate sizing and peak memory tracking, raw pointer traversal for native Go structs, and JSON/YAML parsing extensions, while eliminating quadratic type-checking bottlenecks.

Features

Pull Request Description and Impact
Pratt parser and EnablePrattParser option (#1427, #1433, #1442, #1462, #1472, #1497, #1509, #1511, #1521) Introduces a recursive-descent Pratt parser ported from cel-cpp with iterative parenthesis handling, bounded expression nesting, and escaped function name support, delivering 8x–19x faster single-threaded parsing.
Unified cost model (common/cost), AggregateSizingStrategy, and CostModelVersion (#1430, #1435, #1441, #1474, #1478, #1482, #1512, #1519, #1525, #1537, #1548, #1556, #1558) Unifies static cost estimation and runtime tracking under a declarative cost.OverloadModel AST with container Key/Elem size propagation, aggregate sizing, value-backed ElemOf/KeyOf/ElemTotal/KeyTotal/Length combinators, and versioned compatibility via cel.CostModelVersion.
Runtime peak memory tracking (#1418, #1429) Adds runtime memory tracking and scaled string/byte sizing options to observe and bound peak allocation footprints during evaluation.
Native raw pointer traversal, generic containers, and type aliasing (#1463, #1498, #1503, #1515) Accelerates cel.NativeTypes struct field selection and presence checks via unsafe.Pointer offset traversal, adds generic Go slice/map adapters, and supports native type aliasing.
JSON/YAML parsing and encoding & URL-safe Base64 (#1451, #1461, #1492) Adds json.parse, yaml.parse, and yaml.encode extensions (returning optional_type with 10MB payload safety limits), alongside base64.encodeUrl and base64.decodeUrl in ext.Encoders.
List presence helpers and versioned optional macros (#1447, #1448, #1487) Introduces hasOnly, hasAny, hasAll, and hasExactly in ext.Lists, optional.hasValue(val) in OptionalTypesVersion(3), and single-evaluation optMap/optFlatMap macros in OptionalTypesVersion(4).
HMAC digest and constant-time equality (#1450) Extends ext/security/hmac with hmac.digest and linear-time equality comparisons.
Late-bound functions from Activation (#1483) Enables resolving cel.FunctionVars bindings dynamically from the runtime Activation or cel.Globals.
Type-check error suggestions and cel.Env JSON serialization (#1500, #1554) Adds edit-distance spellchecking and library enablement hints for undeclared symbols/types, plus JSON/YAML config serialization for cel.Env.
AST structural equivalence and @block call tagging (#1467, #1544) Provides format-insensitive AST structural comparison in common/ast and tags cel.@block calls in compiled ASTs.
SLSA + Sigstore artifact signing and OSS-Fuzz consolidation (#1426, #1577) Signs release artifacts with SLSA/Sigstore provenance and consolidates OSS-Fuzz harnesses under fuzzing/.

Fixes

Pull Request Impact and Technical Details
Undo failed assignability checks in place (#1575) Replaces full type-mapping clones during overload resolution with an in-place undo log, eliminating O(N^2) type-checking latency and memory growth on long conjunctions (#1553).
Restore v0.32.0 cost behavior at CostModelVersion(0) and v0.29.2 cost limit error (#1571, #1572, #1573) Restores EvalCancelledError ("operation cancelled: actual cost limit exceeded") when runtime cost limits are exceeded and replays v0.32.0 static/runtime cost rules when pinned to cel.CostModelVersion(0).
Fix unsafe math and saturation in cost estimation and tracking (#1508, #1541) Adds SafeSubtract, SafeTrunc, and SafeMultiplyByFactorTrunc in common/cost so uint64 and float-scaled costs saturate cleanly at math.MaxUint64 (including NaN) and clamp negative values to 0.
Nil-safe Program evaluation and concurrent cost tracker race fix (#1480, #1484, #1486, #1488) Makes Eval, ContextEval, and ConcurrentEval nil-safe, eliminates a data race when capturing cost trackers across goroutines, and removes time-based flakiness in interrupt checks.
Constant folding and partial evaluation AST consistency (#1446, #1453, #1517, #1518) Prunes folded nodes from reference and type maps, checks unknowns before traversing attribute qualifiers, and fixes custom Foldable two-variable iteration.
Native types embedded json:"-" tags and proto.ReflectMessage dereference (#1452, #1551, #1567) Respects json:"-" skip tags on embedded Go structs, fixes JSON tag conversion in ConvertToNative, and prevents invalid field dereferences over proto.ReflectMessage.
Fix regex counted repetition sizing panic (#1438) Prevents a panic when estimating compiled regex program sizes for counted repetitions.

Updates `github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2` from 2.30.0 to 2.33.0
Release notes

Sourced from github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2's releases.

v2.33.0

Notice to all users

This release contains a security fix that changes the behavior of header parsing in the gateway. As part of fixing #7281, the decision was made to stop automatically adding client headers with the Grpc-Metadata- prefix into the grpc metadata by default. This behavior can be restored using the new mux option WithLegacyHeaderMatching. See https://grpc-ecosystem.github.io/grpc-gateway/docs/operations/security_considerations/#request-headers-become-grpc-metadata-under-a-prefix for more information.

Changes

Updates `go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/bridges/prometheus` from 0.71.0 to 0.72.0
Changelog

Sourced from go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/bridges/prometheus's changelog.

[1.47.0/2.6.0/0.72.0/0.38.0/0.27.0/0.21.0/0.17.0/0.19.0] - 2026-10-03

Added

  • Add NewResourceDetectorWithOptions and the WithAWSLogger option to go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/detectors/aws/ec2/v2, allowing a custom AWS SDK logging.Logger to be supplied to the EC2 resource detector. (#9132)
  • Add go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/detectors/openshift, a new resource detector for OpenShift 4 clusters, ported from processor/resourcedetectionprocessor/internal/openshift in opentelemetry-collector-contrib. Detects k8s.cluster.name, and cloud.provider, cloud.platform and cloud.region for clusters running on AWS, Google Cloud and IBM Cloud; Azure clusters report cloud.provider and cloud.platform only. (#9499)
  • Add go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/detectors/kubeadm, a new resource detector for kubeadm-provisioned Kubernetes clusters, ported from processor/resourcedetectionprocessor/internal/kubeadm in opentelemetry-collector-contrib. Detects k8s.cluster.name from the ClusterConfiguration document in the kube-system/kubeadm-config ConfigMap and k8s.cluster.uid from the kube-system namespace UID. (#9500)

Changed

  • Client metrics in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp no longer include attributes from the server-side Labeler, preventing attributes such as http.route from leaking into outbound requests. This is a breaking change for applications that use ContextWithLabeler to add custom client metric attributes: use ContextWithClientLabeler / ClientLabelerFromContext or the WithMetricAttributesFn option instead. Server-side use of ContextWithLabeler / LabelerFromContext is unchanged. (#8924)
  • Stop emitting the legacy http.read_bytes and http.wrote_bytes attributes on the per-operation span events enabled by WithMessageEvents in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp. The read and write events remain, while total body sizes continue to be recorded on the server span as http.request.body.size and http.response.body.size according to HTTP semantic conventions. (#9624)

Deprecated

  • Deprecate go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/otelaws. (#9707)
  • Deprecate go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/propagators/aws. (#9706)
  • Deprecate go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/samplers/probability/consistent. (#9633)
  • Deprecate ReadBytesKey, ReadErrorKey, WroteBytesKey, and WriteErrorKey in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp. The identifiers remain available and their values are unchanged, but WithMessageEvents no longer emits http.read_bytes or http.wrote_bytes. There is no semantic-convention replacement for per-read or per-write byte counts or the human-readable error fields. Use HTTPRequestBodySizeKey and HTTPResponseBodySizeKey from go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.43.0 to record total body sizes on the span. If an error causes the HTTP request to fail, set the span status to Error and record ErrorType(err) from go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.43.0 on the span. (#9624)

Fixed

  • Treat empty Prometheus exporter environment variable values as unset in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/exporters/autoexport, restoring the documented defaults. (#9636)
  • Bound converter-owned recursive map, slice, array, and pointer traversal in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/bridges/otellogr, go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/bridges/otellogrus, go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/bridges/otelslog, and go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/bridges/otelzap. A field requiring more than 100 such levels is replaced with <max-depth-exceeded> and the record continues to be emitted. Existing fmt and user-method behavior remains unchanged. (#9691)
  • Format span attributes in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/zpages using attribute.Value.String instead of the deprecated attribute.Value.Emit, following the OpenTelemetry AnyValue representation for non-OTLP protocols. (#9453)
  • Set error.type on the span and on the request-duration, request-body-size, and response-body-size metrics when a client disconnects mid-request in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/github.com/gin-gonic/gin/otelgin, using the request context's cancellation error as the classification source when the handler has not already recorded an error via c.Error. Previously a disconnect was recorded with span status Error and no error.type, indistinguishable from a genuine server fault. (#9394)
  • Report Prometheus metrics HTTP server errors in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/otelconf when using the v0.2.0 configuration schema. The error check was inverted, so a clean shutdown (http.ErrServerClosed) was reported as unexpected while real Serve errors were ignored. (#9653)
  • Fix temporary file cleanup for multipart requests in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp by copying the parsed multipart form back to the original request during deferred cleanup, preserving net/http cleanup during panic unwinding for HTTP/2 panic handling and outer recovery middleware paths. Unrecovered HTTP/1 handler panics remain uncleaned because net/http skips finishRequest in that path. (#9685)
  • Fix http.client.request.body.size recording for streaming request bodies in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp. (#8684)
  • Bound Kubernetes ConfigMap requests in go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/detectors/aws/eks with a 10-second timeout so Detect cannot hang indefinitely when the caller-provided context has no deadline. (#9419)

Removed

  • Drop support for [Go 1.25]. (#9584)
  • Remove go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/github.com/labstack/echo/otelecho. Use github.com/labstack/echo-opentelemetry instead. (#9613)
